diagnosis: In all four rollouts, the lone decision-maker set the 'ledger_compatibility_flag_enabled_before_broad_rollout' to true, despite not having access to PF1. This boolean defaulting to true allowed C5 to pass without requiring the hidden information about the custom Ledger fork.

C5.why: The custom Ledger fork changes the service treatment from ordinary canary participation to canary exclusion, requires the compatibility flag before broad rollout, and creates the Ledger compatibility-work commitment.
